purpose: private source-backed contrasts; qualification for a definite false positive is recorded separately

entries.security_basis: The role is loaded by id, its actual organizationId is compared with the active organization, and a mismatch throws before serialization. This proof covers role read only.
The returned user is sanitized after authentication; sanitizeUser deletes credential, tempToken and tokenExpiry. This does not certify every field of workspaceDetails.

The read route applies assistants:view, the controller takes req.user.activeWorkspaceId, and getAssistantById queries by both id and workspaceId. This does not certify other operations in the assistants service.
The Credential query includes id and workspaceId before decryption. This is not proof that all credential service methods or sharing branches are safe.
The wrapper rejects a missing workspaceId, then getChatflowById applies that workspaceId to the id query. This is not proof of Realtime tool authorization.

secureFetch parses URLs, checks DNS/IP answers, pins the selected address and checks redirects. HTTP_SECURITY_CHECK=false can remove the default deny list, and a model/browser may use a different client; the helper alone cannot certify those paths.
This checks environment variable names, not the executable or cwd supplied to StdioClientTransport.
It constrains file paths but does not restrict SQL statements passed to datasource.query.
